title: INHA WORLD Campus Semantic to Physical Feature Crosswalk (Candidate)
description: Non-1:1 crosswalk mapping between campus semantic entities (building numbers and named spaces) and physical geospatial features from 국토교통부 GIS건물통합정보 and 건축행정시스템(세움터) building register ledgers.

promotionRules.description: Rules required to promote a candidate physical mapping to canonical Reality Base status. Attribute-only matches are strictly insufficient for footprint promotion.

criteria.RULE_A: Authoritative registered dong name directly identifies the semantic building (e.g. '7동 (7호관 학생회관)').
criteria.RULE_B: Multiple authoritative sources independently identify the same physical feature.
criteria.RULE_C: Official campus spatial geometry and government GIS feature align without contradiction.

currentAuthority.notes: Current authoritative campus semantic identity is 7호관 (verified via official campus map). Cadastral entity is located in the western sector (Feature #39, 254m WNW of Agora), with registeredDongName '7동 (7호관 학생회관)' satisfying Promotion Rule A.

evidence: Registered dong name explicitly reads '7동 (7호관 학생회관)'.
Total gross floor area is 15,764.76 m², matching both the official air quality report (15,764.76 m²) and AURUM architectural record (15,758 m², architect Sungryong Cho, 1986).
Floors (G6/B1) and reinforced concrete structure match AURUM and campus records.
discrepancies: OSM Way #218038027 historically misapplied the 'Student Center' tag to Feature #1 next to Agora Plaza, which this crosswalk refutes.

currentAuthority.notes: Building 6 remains unresolved. Feature #1 is registered as 5-5동 (5북서관) despite housing the vernacular Business School wing flanking Agora Plaza. Feature #28 matches total floor area exactly but is spatially distant (218m NW). Neither satisfies canonical promotion rules for Building 6 footprint.

evidence: Physically wraps directly around the northern and eastern boundary of Agora Plaza (10.19m minimum distance).
Official campus maps depict Building 6 (Business School) occupying the eastern wing of this continuous courtyard structure.
Vernacular student documentation describes Agora Plaza as enclosed in a ㄷ-shape by Buildings 6 and 9.
discrepancies: Government cadastral register designates this physical mass under the Building 5 complex identifier (5-5동, 5북서관) rather than Building 6.
The physical mass has 3,907.61 m² footprint and 20,186.11 m² gross floor area, representing an agglomerated academic complex.

evidence: Government building register explicitly lists dong name as '6동 (6호관)'.
Total gross floor area in register is 12,268.57 m², exactly matching the Inha official indoor air quality inspection report (12,268.57 m²).
Approval date is 1982-04-01, matching the early 1982 construction timeline.
discrepancies: Spatial location is 218.39 m northwest of Agora Plaza, contradicting vernacular descriptions of Building 6 immediately bordering Agora Plaza.

currentAuthority.notes: Building 9 remains unresolved. Feature #12 matches the official completion date to the exact day (1981-08-06), but total gross floor area differs and it is separated by 93.30m from Agora Plaza. It is classified as ATTRIBUTE_MATCH_ONLY and cannot be promoted to canonical footprint.

evidence: Approval date is 1981-08-06 (81.08.06), exactly matching Inha University's official building completion register for Building 9 to the exact day.
Footprint area is 2,733.35 m² with G5/B1 floor configuration.
Positioned in the southern campus wing south of Agora Plaza, matching the general campus map placement of College of Social Sciences.
discrepancies: Distance to Agora Plaza is 93.30m across an open lawn/plaza; it does not touch the Agora polygon boundary directly.
Total floor area in GIS is 17,340.2 m², whereas air quality report listed 7,900.67 m² (indicating possible sub-dong partition in the air quality scope).

currentAuthority.notes: Large multi-wing complex constructed between 1979 and 1983. Feature #1 is registered as 5-5동 (5북서관) and satisfies Promotion Rule A for Building 5.

evidence: Cadastral dong name directly confirms assignment to Building 5 complex (5-5동, 5북서관).
Approval date 1983-09-09 aligns with the multi-phase construction of Building 5 extensions.
3,907.61 m² footprint forms the primary physical enclosure of Agora Plaza.

currentAuthority.notes: Officially verified outdoor plaza between Building 5/6 and Building 9. Polygon geometry verified from OpenStreetMap Way #1099894035.

evidence: 8-vertex WGS84 closed polygon representing the paved plaza surface.
Directly surveyed in OSM with area 599.0 m².
Sits 10.19m southwest of Feature #1 (5-5동) and 93.30m northeast of Feature #12 (Building 9 candidate).
